name: run_on_thread
description: Runs Luau source on a specific Luau thread. The call returns no values produced by the dispatched source.

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: Target Luau thread used to run the source.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Non-empty Luau source string to run on the target thread.

parameters.name: ...arguments
parameters.description: Additional values passed to the dispatched source when supported.
